title: R2 cleanup: delete the 4 deprecated weights no release since 1.3.1 installs (78.4 GB, Wan 2.2 t2v pair + LTX fp8/mxfp8)
description: Found by the 2026-10-11 R2 audit (Fabio: bill ~$7.8/mo on 532.7 GB and rising, approved this delete). wan-22-t2v-high/low (MPI-470, 29.1 GB) and ltx23-transformer-fp8/mxfp8 (MPI-466, 49.3 GB) are DEPRECATED dep entries kept so the orphan sweep can reclaim them from user disks; v1.3.1 is the last build that lists them (v1.4.0..v2.0.1 and tester 1.6.2 do not). Steps: (1) KEEP the four DEPS entries but drop their url/mirrorUrl and leave the old URLs in a comment, exactly as MPI-698 did for qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq (assetDeps.js ~1181-1241) - scripts/check-dep-urls.mjs HEADs every DEPS url, so deleting the object while url stays turns release:check red; check nothing else reads dep.url unguarded. (2) rclone deletefile --s3-no-check-bucket the 4 keys under vision/models/diffusion_models/, verify with rclone lsl. (3) HF mirror copies of the Wan t2v pair on Mad-Pony-Interactive/cubric-studio: Fabio's call, R2 only was approved. Not in scope: H3 fl2v 4-step v0.1 LoRA + klein-lora-outpaint (v1.5.0 still installs both) and boogu-qwen3vl-8b-clip (every release incl. 2.0.1 installs it).
